items.title: Video: Welcome to the AUR Referral Program (8:15)
items.description: The full walkthrough: signing up, your dashboard, your QR code and flyer, the rules, and how rewards are paid. Great for anyone thinking about joining.
items.caption:
Thinking about earning referral rewards? This 8-minute walkthrough shows exactly how American Utility Review's referral program works: businesses get a free utility bill review with no upfront cost, and partners can earn a reward when a referral becomes a client. Watch: https://youtu.be/Pi_kjWMWWzs
Sign up: https://aur.neuclix.com/refer.html
